(a)—सम when it means 'equal' is not a pronoun and is
declined like nouns in अ; e. g. सम: समो सम: Nom., समाय D.
sing., समानाम् G. plu. as in the Sutra of Pāṇ. यथासंख्यमनुदेश:
समानाम् । 1. 3. 10.

§ 149. Obs:—स्व and स्व (the 10th and 11th सर्वादि°s) the one
उद्दात्त (uddātta), the other अनुद्दात्त (anudātta), both synonyms of
अन्य are declined like सर्व. The former is of the form स्वत्
according to some and then it is declined regularly by adding
the terminations; e. g. स्वत् स्वतो स्वत: Nom. &c.

§ 150. स्व when it does not mean "a class" or "wealth" is
a pronoun and is declined like सर्व* m. f. n.; but it forms its
